## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: safety and emissions inspections and required equipment
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The authorized inspection station sign is a picture on an earlier page and is not described here; only the fact that authorized stations display it is stated [A01].
The window tint limit is taught exactly as the guide words it, as light blockage on the front door windows, with no outside conversion [A03].
The emissions program phone number and web address are agency contact details and were not turned into facts [A03].
The guide's emissions exemption for low-mileage vehicles refers to miles between biennial safety inspections; that wording was kept and not reinterpreted [A04].
Every fee, model-year cutoff, distance, weight and date was restated in original words and kept exact.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.
